inputs.text: This is bigger than Ben-Gvir’s party pushing a bill. The whole debate looks engineered to make unequal justice and expanded state power seem normal: supporters advance the policy, while opponents denounce it in ways that can make the process look contested and legitimate. The outrage may be part of the cover. The machinery keeps moving, and the death penalty becomes easier to sell as routine.

subtopics: Outrage and contested debate as possible cover
